decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the established offer at low carrying cost and has its own web page, so the option is cheap to hold while demand becomes clear.
The building digital twin service is still uncertain and only mentioned on the website, but it fits an emerging market the firm wants to shape, so keeping the option is worth its modest cost.
The authentication delegation service is close to the core offer and cheap to maintain, though it overlaps with the identity service and could be merged into it.
The open framework is a foundation for the firm's tailored solutions and low-cost to carry, with no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
The identity service was actively promoted at launch and integrates closely with the firm's GIS applications, so its prospects remain open and holding it costs little.
